verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a password manager, but no evidence shows 1Password offers a self-hosted core product. Connect Servers are deployed in a company's infrastructure only to give apps REST API access to items in a 1Password account, which makes them an adjacent component rather than a self-hosted vault service. Community reports describe the loss of local vaults and self-hosting as an option.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
